question: A thick, non-conducting spherical shell, with inner radius $R_1$ and outer radius $R_2$, has a volume charge density $ρ(r) = A/r$. It is observed that the electric field is constant in the region $R_1 \le r \le R_2$. Analyze this condition using Gauss's law. To achieve this, what point charge Q must be placed at the center of the shell?
